name: Jira
description: Reads your Jira tickets and those of the boards you chose into Zeff — the basis of the todos, the context sync and the entries per ticket — through the Jira MCP server (mcp-atlassian). Its reader is a lambda you (or the AI) can mend. Transitions, comments and new tickets are still done by Zeff on your click.
author: Zeff

settings.label: Jira MCP server: command
settings.help: The program that starts the Jira MCP server, e.g. uvx (mcp-atlassian). Carried over from where Zeff had it when you switch.

settings.label: Jira MCP server: arguments
settings.help: Its arguments: a JSON list, or words separated by spaces — e.g. mcp-atlassian.

settings.label: Jira MCP server: environment (with your token)
settings.help: KEY=value lines (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USERNAME, JIRA_API_TOKEN …) or a JSON object — kept encrypted, never shown again.

settings.label: Jira address
settings.help: Where your Jira is (for the tickets' links); empty: the server's JIRA_URL.

settings.label: Your tickets (JQL)
settings.default: assignee = currentUser() ORDER BY updated DESC

settings.label: How many of yours at most
